text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "Waaaaahhhh...!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how many times I visit, it's 
such a lovely city. Cherry blossom season 
was gorgeous, but winter has a wonderfully 
crisp charm to it too."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"So many people in kimono...! Furisode 
look just like paintings, don't they? How 
stylish!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm... Fine, are you truly fine wearing 
your school uniform?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Hm? Oh, it's totally fine! That's a whole 
different matter! Because this is a 
'student trip'!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Japanese students intentionally wear 
their uniforms to amusement parks, don't 
they? Saying it makes for a better 
keepsake than wearing casual clothes."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, you can only wear school uniforms 
right now, after all. 
If it gets cold, we can always buy scarves 
or gloves.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that sounds wonderful! 
Maybe something with a traditional 
Kyoto-style Japanese pattern♪

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
We must certainly take care not to catch a 
cold. 
Shall we head straight to today's main 
event: our shrine and temple tour?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —And... goal!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Phew, these stairs are quite the workout!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa...! They sure live up to their 
reputation for being super long! 
This might actually be great for training♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Pheeew...! We've arrived~!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Laurel-san, are you alright? 
You seemed to be stopping quite often 
along the way...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Eh? Ah, I was just looking down at the 
town. Look, isn't it so pretty...♪ 
Sorry, did I make you wait?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you two! Apparently there's an even 
bigger shrine further up! 
I'm heading on ahead~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yep, we'll catch up right away! 
...Let's go, Ikuno-chan!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Deep breath in... and out~~~~! 
The air tastes so good, too...♪

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Laurel-san... Shall we take a short break? 
Let us take things slowly.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Hm? Ikuno-chan, did you get tired?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No, well... 
I was concerned about the condition of 
your legs, Laurel-san.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...! 
I see, so you were worried about me.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It may be meddlesome of me, but... 
I am well aware of what happened during 
your Junior year, Laurel-san.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Plagued by leg fragility around your 
debut... 
Forced to sit out the Classics as well...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Even if you are a GⅠ Umamusume now, one's 
constitution is something that always 
lingers... 
Carelessness is strictly forbidden.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Ikuno-chan.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, you two... 
? Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Nope, nooothing at all! 
Ikuno-chan was just being sweet♪

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No, it is merely standard risk management. 
Um, if you do not mind, I could apply some 
preventative taping...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'm really, truly okay! Oh, why don't we 
play that game? 
Rock, paper, scissors! 
P-A-T-R-O-L--T-O-W-E-R...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: (Even though I said that...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Does it still look like I'm just putting 
on a brave face? 
...I'm reaaally totally fine, though~~!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, well, you can't blame her for not 
believing your 'I'm fine,' Laurel.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Because you... always, under any 
circumstances, 
manage to smile no matter how painful it 
is.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
If words won't get through to her, 
you'll just have to bust out and show her, 
won't you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Show her... huh. 
Fufu, you're not worried about me at all, 
are you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Bubble-chan. 
Alright! In that case... maybe I'll bust 
loose even more♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: —Hup, hup, hup! Hyaaaaaaaah—!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, good work, everyone! Hey hey, this is 
delicious! 
It's limited-edition Uji matcha flavor♪ I 
got tired of waiting and bought some.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa! L-Laurel! You...! 
Why on earth did you sprint in a straight 
line the whole way back...?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Well, going downhill picks up speed and 
feels so good, right? 
I just really wanted to feel the wind♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, even if it is a designated 
Umamusume path, you were speeding far too 
much. 
Do not forget that this is a group outing.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa...! 
Laurel-san, if you feel any abnormality in 
your legs, please tell me immediately.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. But I seem completely fine♪ 
Hey, next up is shopping along the main 
avenue, right? Hurry, hurry!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Laurel-san...! 
I only hope she doesn't develop a fever 
later on...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: *giggle*... Come on, Ikuno, let's go too.
